content.title: Carabao | Filipino Eatery | Napa
content.text: 0 Make a Reservation Order Online A Celebration of Filipino Flavor Reservations recommended — walk-ins welcome as space allows.Lunch: Saturday, 11:30 a.m. – 2:30 p.m.Dinner: Tuesday – Saturday, 5 p.m. – 9 p.m.Carabao is an intimate, 12-table dining room with just 6 seats at the bar and 4 at the chef’s counter. We recommend reserving ahead to ensure availability and to give our team time to prepare for your visit with the care and attention every guest deserves. Make a Reservation MissionTo celebrate the flavors, stories, culture, and community of the Filipino people—and to bring the rich flavors of Filipino cuisine to Napa Valley while honoring the resilience, dedication, and hard work of Filipinos around the world. Through bold yet approachable flavors, top-quality ingredients, and expert craftsmanship, we strive to make Filipino cuisine exciting and accessible to all. AboutCarabao is a Filipino restaurant by Michelin-trained Chef Jade Cunningham, located in Napa Valley. Founded in partnership with Mathew Cunningham and the Amparo and Eric F. Gonzales Family Fund, Carabao celebrates the stories, resilience, and culinary traditions of the Filipino people. Carabao comes from the national animal of the Philippines—a water buffalo known for its strength, perseverance, and deep connection to the Filipino identity. As a young girl growing up in Bulacan, Philippines, Chef Jade witnessed carabaos firsthand and grew up embodying their traits of perseverance, patience, and strength through her hardiness and impeccable work ethic. These same values are reflected in every detail of the Carabao experience.Chef Jade brings a bold and heartfelt vision to life—blending the food she grew up with and the refined techniques of Michelin-star kitchens. Carabao is the first restaurant of its kind in Napa Valley: a refined yet accessible space that invites guests to discover, savor, and celebrate Filipino cuisine.
